caption: The drawing shows a single garment, specifically an outer coat and bonnet combination, centrally positioned on a plain beige background. The coat is long, reaching almost to the bottom edge of the drawing, with a slightly flared shape. The main body of the coat is a brownish or olive green color with some shaded areas to indicate folds and shadows. The cuffs and the bonnet ribbon are purple. The coat is open at the front, revealing a pink lining that runs the length of the inside. The bonnet on top features a purple exterior, a scalloped edge outlined in a darker shade, and a quilted pink interior with a diamond pattern; the bonnet is trimmed with a purple ribbon that forms a bow at the neck and a smaller bow at the top. The coat is depicted without a visible wearer, with the bonnet area left blank except for the background pattern.
title: Lady's Pelisse
